turns.patient_opening: Doctor: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on? Patient: I’m a 60-year-old woman, and about 30 minutes ago I suddenly lost vision in my right eye while I was watching TV. It was painless and there hasn’t been any change in my left eye.

turns.patient_answer: I haven’t noticed any swelling in my joints. I haven’t had joint pains or redness either—my main problem is the sudden, painless vision loss in my right eye that started about 30 minutes ago.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bumps, sores, or unusual spots on your scalp?
turns.patient_answer: I haven’t noticed any bumps, sores, or unusual spots on my scalp. I also haven’t had any eye pain or recent trauma.

turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t had any itching or skin itchiness. My only issue is the sudden, painless vision loss in my right eye that began about 30 minutes ago.

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any trouble lifting your arms above your head?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t had any trouble lifting my arms above my head. My only concern is the sudden, painless loss of vision in my right eye that started about 30 minutes ago, with no symptoms in my left eye.
